breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to use the bending second moment I = π d^4/64 for torsion calculations. The generated specification correctly removed this erroneous instruction and instead specified the use of the correct polar second moment of area, J = π * d^4 / 32, which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
